t.zh: 模型写完自己以为该写的，就说「做完了」，不管测试。新元件<part-ref to="part:test"></part-ref>在模型说做完或要求测试时跑一遍测试：给出一份报告，和测试是否通过。
t.en: Once the model has written what it thinks it should, it says it is done, tests or not. The new part <part-ref to="part:test"></part-ref> runs the tests when the model says it is done or asks for them: it gives a report, and whether the tests pass.

after.zh: 模型说做完了，不等于做完了。把「停」交给测试，模型的话就要被检查；失败的报告接回上下文，它下一轮就照着改。
after.en: The model saying it is done does not make it done. Hand Stop to the tests and its word gets checked; a failing report fed back into its context is what it fixes by next turn.

brief.zh: 这两个 issue 的改法容易写错。让机器改到测试通过才停。
brief.en: These two issues are easy to get wrong. Have the machine go on until the tests pass.

hint.zh: 先用之前的停法跑一次，看最后一轮测试是什么样。
hint.en: Run it once with the old way of stopping, and look at the tests after the last turn.
Stop also takes a pass flag.
